fusions.name: Spat Bile
fusions.desc: Spits a gob of venomous bile that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Strangling Coil
fusions.desc: Wraps both arms around the target and squeezes for 18 damage, using up every affliction you have on it and dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Still in the Grass
fusions.desc: Goes utterly still and veils you for 8 seconds, and you move 10% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Waiting Grip
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
